title: Hay Que --- Somebody Has To, and Nobody in Particular
label: ch:hay-que
canDo: I can express an obligation without naming who is obliged.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C54-hay-que: produce hay que hablar espanol and name the other construction that leaves the person out.
payoff.note: Pairs with the impersonal se: one says something happens without a doer, the other says something must happen without one.
